answer: Require every agent to lock a ferrous-hard stake, a refundable bond of scarce tokens, before it can transact, with the stake slashed if peers prove it ran duplicate identities. Reaching the summit of trust then demands real capital per identity, so a Sybil farmer must fund each fake separately while honest agents recover their bond. A reputation pulse of periodic peer attestations that decay unless renewed keeps dormant sock-puppets from accumulating standing for free. The cost of attack scales linearly with fakes, while honest participation stays cheap.
